text_block_list.text: —And then, the day of the Fan Appreciation Festival arrived.
Symboli Rudolf stood on the special stage to deliver the opening ceremony speech.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—In a media interview the other day,
I took the liberty of dubbing today's event the "Grand Fan Appreciation Festival."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: At that time, I explained that we were projecting a larger scale than usual, with more than double the attendance, but...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"There is another reason
why I added 'Great' to it."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Because it encompasses the sheer depth of our gratitude toward all the fans.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It is precisely because fans take an interest in our races
and come to cheer us on
that we are able to pursue our dreams...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
We run at full speed to repay that support.
Yet our gratitude runs too deep for running alone to suffice.
And so...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: "At this event, we would like to express our gratitude to each and every one of you."

Though it was a formal greeting, the gathered fans
listened attentively to Symboli Rudolf's noble demeanor—
or so it seemed, until...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: And so, to conclude, allow me to present one last witty pun.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—To all who "sympathize" with our path,
"today, I give my thanks"!
(Gasp...!)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...!?
There was no such pun in the manuscript!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Dammit, they got me!
That was an ad-lib...!

Tension ran through the student council officers as well.
At that moment, the fans—

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ohh... Oooooh!?
I think whatever you just said was pretty profound!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I don't really get what it means,
but Symboli Rudolf is just so cool as always~!
(Clap clap clap clap clap...!)

A thunderous round of applause erupts throughout the venue.
However, as for Symboli Rudolf herself...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
No, was it too hard to understand?
I still have much to learn...
I was reflecting on my mistakes...

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Was that... a pun?
Huh, what do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Kyoukansha... Kyou, kansha.
Ahhh~~!! It's a pun!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"...I've kinda wondered about this from time to time, but...
is the President actually making puns?"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, actually, I thought so too...!
I was wondering if *the* President really would, but..."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Wait, both of them!?
Then it really is...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: The President likes puns?! No way!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
The "Emperor" made a pun...!
Whoaaa...!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Wahahahaha...!
Way to go, Symboli Rudolfー!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Ooh...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is smiling.
It was worth pulling out my best material!

Though entirely unintentional,
Symboli Rudolf's pun warmed up the venue tremendously!
